dedupe_keys.name: emprises de stationnement sur le secteur payant de rennes

description: Emprises de stationnement sur le secteur payant de Rennes is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Cette couche de polygones représente l'emprise des zones de stationnement sur l'ensemble du secteur de stationnement payant de Rennes. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are place de stationnement. The portal shows 4,235 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-12-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
